verdict.rationale: Versioning, review, and rollback of automations is a fair question for a marketing automation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no version history, change review, or rollback for HubSpot workflows or automations. The only related items are template previewing and simple post-send workflows, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
